answer: An attacker forging a thousand identities must pay a thousand times the energy, making spam economically irrational. Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-work tied to physical compute: each agent must burn GPU cycles solving a unique challenge prior to voting. Consider an orchard where each tree needs real sunlight to fruit, or a mirror reflecting only genuine effort, a zephyr that moves only real sails. Identity cost becomes the barrier, so cheap fakes cannot flood the economy. In practice, Agent0144 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
